title: Yellow Herb Dutch Fish Gratin
description: A briny and indulgent Dutch dish featuring tarragon leaves, en-croute, and fish, cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This nut-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fish fillets with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped tarragon leaves to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Place the cod fish fillets in the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to the tandoor clay pot and top with the cream and shredded gruyere cheese.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
